value.rationale: The six adjacent lengths form the entire first nontrivial seven-point replication interval after the classical binary rank-three simplex. They give exact expected read counts for binary data retrieval under natural uniform-with-replacement sampling, and a complete structural classification of every optimal code. The Fano nonlinearity at three and four duplicate types supplies meaningful incidence information not specified by the already known uniform optimum or a cheap rounding argument. General k or arbitrary n claims are deliberately absent.
